hero.headline: ExactKV shows when compressed KV caches start lying.
hero.subhead: A compressor-agnostic crash-test and leaderboard for LLM KV-cache compression. It measures the first token where compressed KV diverges from the full-KV verifier, plus acceptance rate, verifier agreement, and exactness failures.

positioning: ExactKV is a research-grade evaluation framework. It is not a production serving system and does not reproduce VeriCache.

required_caveats: Phase F kernel results are a kernel microbenchmark only, not an end-to-end inference speedup.
Compression ratios are stored tensor byte ratios, not active GPU memory savings.
SpectralQuant runs in fallback/proxy mode when the real dependency is unavailable.
Shard is a probe-first heuristic, not a full Shard / ShardCache integration.
ExactKV is inspired by verifier-mediated compressed-KV ideas. it does not reproduce VeriCache.
ExactKV is not a production serving system.
exactkv_failures = 0 is a hard gate on the tested panel only.
Scale run used sequential model execution (volume constraint).
External panel drift rates are not official LongBench/BFCL/MBPP leaderboard scores.
